items.statement: Customer funds received before remittance and card transactions are completed drive current liabilities and cash balances
items.quote: So basically, our business involves receiving customer funds before underlying remittances and card transactions are completed. So, a substa ntial portion of these balances are associated with that, with the corresponding liabilities which are there

items.statement: CFO states H1 FY27 EBITDA is ₹12.5 Cr
items.quote: EBITDA say ₹12.5 Cr for H1 result.

items.statement: Management plans a preferential issue of around Rs 40-45 crore to fund the AutoPay acquisition, payable by June 2027.
items.quote: And, rest around 40 crore, 40 to 45 crore, or a little over then, depending on the market, which we are supposed to pay in June 2027. We are planning to do a pref round for that as well, right?

items.statement: Unsecured loans from promoter entities are less than INR2 crores.
items.quote: Yes, the total unsecured loan from the promoters, it is not that significant. I think it is less than INR2 crores.

items.statement: Majority of receivables are from government agencies with minimal recovery risk; collections typically complete in H2.
items.quote: Majority of our receivables, they are due from government agencies and this is not only the case for us, but for the entire industry.

items.statement: Working capital cycle expected to shorten to 5-6 months by March FY27 from current 8 months for micro-irrigation.
items.quote: So I think on a consolidated basis, it should come around 5 to 6 months at the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Inventory buildup in H1 FY27 due to unbilled work-in-progress for NPCI and Bank of Abyssinia, unbilled redemption revenue, and unsold gift voucher inventory
items.quote: So, key reason behind this, like, inventory, it's actually divided into two parts. One is, the work in progress. And then one is inventory with us, right?

items.statement: Merchant promotion revenue billed after 30-45 days due to return/refund periods, contributing to unbilled inventory
items.quote: Third is redemption revenue, which was, Which, the redemption has happened, but, we haven't built it yet, right? So those are the three elements under which.

items.statement: AutoPay acquisition funded 20% via share swap, 40 crore from internal accruals and IPO proceeds, remaining 40-45 crore via preferential round by June 2027
items.quote: Some, around 20% off is through the, share swap, and then, rest of the, like, around 40 crore will be paid by, Our internal, accruals. Which are available in the company, and some IPO proceeds can be used for that as well. And, rest around 40 crore, 40 to 45 crore, or a little over then, depending on the market, which we are supposed to pay in June 2027. We are planning to do a pref round for that

items.statement: Operating cash flow was negative INR9 crores in H1 FY27 due to working capital absorption of INR10 crores
items.quote: H1 FY27 PAT we have recorded about INR5.09 crores and operating cash flow was negative for about negative INR9 crores. So working capital absorbed like INR10 crores in the period.

items.statement: Management expects operating cash flow to remain negative in H2 FY27
items.quote: So can we conclude that cash flow from operations is going to be like negative in H2 also? Sumit Bajaj: Yes.

items.statement: Trade receivables increased 80% YoY with aging of 90-120 days; expected to reduce in H2
items.quote: Our trade receivables increased by almost 80% on a Y-o-Y basis. So why is it so and like what is the aging of these trade receivables? Sumit Bajaj: See, normally our aging is between 90 to 120 days.

items.statement: Inventory levels were higher in H1 FY27 due to replenishment; expected to normalize next year
items.quote: In telecom segment, we service across the country, so we have to have inventory at almost, you know, every location. So that's why our inventory has been a bit higher side.
